Container.Name: GymNote
Container.Overview: Gym Note - A self-hosted, local-first workout tracker for personal or family use. Exercise library with GIFs, custom exercises, group/routine builders, fixed and rolling workout schedules, workout logging with PR tracking, body weight tracking, body-composition report scanning (OCR from smart-scale screenshots), weekly muscle heatmap, analytics, Excel export, multi-user support, backup/restore, offline-capable PWA install on mobile, and 11 UI languages. The bundled exercise dataset is intended for personal, educational, and non-commercial use. This is a personal project shared as-is.
Container.Changes: [b]2026-10-01[/b] - Renamed Gym App to Gym Note (new image ghcr.io/thaihoang987/gym-note) - Added Italian language (11 UI languages) - Body-composition scan, per-metric history charts and many stability fixes Full history: https://github.com/thaihoang987/Gym-Note/commits/main

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port to access the web interface. Open http://your-ip:3001 in your browser.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Where the database, uploaded images, and logs are stored. Back this up regularly!

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the default admin account on first run. Change this before starting! Only applies when creating a fresh database.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone for correct date/time display. E.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, America/New_York, Europe/London.

Config.Name: Server Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal server port. Keep this matching the Web Port above.
